metadata.description: Do research in the open: project management, context management, and publishing with citable data releases.

plugins.name: open-science
plugins.description: Install first: the onboard skill, which asks which components you want and sets them up.

plugins.name: open-science-project
plugins.description: Component 1, project management: new-project, new-task, context-files, migrate-project, update-from-template.

plugins.name: open-science-context

plugins.name: slurm-resurrect
plugins.description: Optional extra: resume Claude Code sessions in a fresh SLURM job when the current job reaches its time limit.
